snippet.title: Dreadline Express | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Dreadline Express is a first-person psychological horror metroidbrainia set aboard humanity’s last train. Explore its mysterious carriages and meet the survivors within as you investigate the secrets surrounding their journey. Collect clue cards to unlock new conversations and paths, using what you learn to decide where your investigation takes you next. On the Dreadline Express, knowledge is the key to moving forward. [steam wishlist - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3327120/Dreadline_Express/]
--
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
